title: Rita Gunther McGrath (Columbia Business School · Thinkers50 Top 10) — 'Loved your talk at the #nacdsummit and yes you can taste it!'
summary: McGrath teaches strategy at Columbia Business School, ranks in the Thinkers50 top ten, and wrote Seeing Around Corners. She replied on X to Eric's NACD Directors Summit keynote, picking up his line about value extraction being something customers can taste.
